title: WPSS/469/2012 of GYAN SWAROOP GROWER Vs MANAGING DIRECTOR HMT WATCHES and ANOTHER

paras.text:
WPSS No. 469 of 2012
Hon'ble Tarun Agarwala, J.
Mr. B.D. Pande, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. Chetan Joshi, Advocate for the
respondents.
Upon hearing the learned counsel for the
petitioner, the Court finds that the petitioner
took a voluntary retirement from Karnal,
Chandigarh in the year 2003 and, now, after 9
years has approached the writ court seeking a
direction from the respondents to pay certain
outstanding amounts. In the opinion of the
Court since the petitioner took a voluntary
retirement from Karnal, Chandigarh, no cause of
action arises in the territory of Uttarakhand. The
writ petition is dismissed.
